data.action: 赤足蜷坐于宽厚窗台抱膝，侧首凝望窗外荒原晚霞
data.camera: medium shot, eye level, 中景平视，窗台木框、抱膝少女与窗外地平线同框
data.description: 罗德岛生活区单人宿舍内，史尔特尔赤足蜷坐在宽厚的木制窗台上，双臂环抱着膝盖，静静注视着窗外地平线上翻滚的晚霞与苍茫荒原。晚风吹拂着额前酒红色的发丝，夕阳将她的剪影拉得很长。
data.lighting: 窗外漫天铺洒的赤金色夕阳余晖与室内阴影
data.location: 罗德岛生活区个人宿舍窗台
data.promptProse: Perched barefoot on a wide wooden windowsill inside her quarters, Surtr sits hugging her knees comfortably. She gazes out the large window at vast desolate plains stretching toward a fiery amber sunset, warm golden dusk washing over her quiet profile.
data.title: 史尔特尔 · 宿舍窗畔的晚霞抱膝
data.animaCaption: Sitting barefoot on the windowsill with knees hugged close, she gazes across the distant plains in the amber dusk.
